title: PUMA: Stock Rating and New Kit Launch
description: Recent updates regarding PUMA include a maintained stock rating and the launch of a new rugby kit, according to reports.

sources.title: ALL ROADS LEAD TO LOFTUS AS PUMA AND VODACOM BULLS LAUNCH NEW KIT

sections.heading: Financial Rating
paragraphs: According to MarketScreener, RBC has maintained a Neutral rating on PUMA SE.

sections.heading: Rugby Kit Launch
paragraphs: According to Vodacom Bulls, PUMA and the Vodacom Bulls have launched a new kit at Loftus.
SA Rugby magazine reports that the Bulls revealed this new kit during a clash with the All Blacks.
